symptom: `describe enumeration` writes a caption with an apostrophe as `V1 'It's a test'`, which does not re-parse (`the statement ending at '<missing ')'>' has no terminating ;`); a folder path with an apostrophe the same
cause: describeEnumeration hand-rolled `'%s'` for the caption and the folder clause instead of mdlQuote; cmd_enumerations.go was not in the list scanned by TestDescribers_HaveNoHandRolledStringLiterals because the file also holds many prose error messages containing `'%s'`
fix: Caption and folder go through mdlQuote(ctx, …), so the escape follows the describe language (mdl 1 doubles, mdl 0 also escapes backslash/line break)
insight: The #1006 source-scan guard only covers the files it lists; a describer living in a file dominated by validation prose escaped it. A re-parse test on the emitted statement, under both describe languages, is the guard that does not depend on a file list. Twice-exec checked on a PedApp copy: describe -> exec reports Unchanged and touches no file
